items.title: FINRA Bars Former LPL Rep For Taking $1.7M From Clients

items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) appointed Calvert Lange as Senior Vice President and Head of Payments: Merchant and Institutional Sales Group. Lange will oversee payments and treasury management coverage for technology, transportation, consumer, and hospitality sector clients. She joins U.S. Bancorp after previous senior roles at Citi and Deutsche Bank focused on institutional payments and cash management.
